items.title: Integrated terminal
items.scope: Desktop now provides an explicit project terminal through xterm and an owner-bound pseudoterminal. It starts in the approved root with a filtered environment, preserves a bounded session transcript, stops with project and window lifecycle, and states clearly that the shell is not sandboxed.

items.title: Local MCP server
items.scope: Desktop now exposes an explicit-start, project-scoped Streamable HTTP endpoint with a session token and four bounded read-only tools. Host and Origin checks, secret-path denial, and renderer/project/app lifecycle revocation keep local automation narrow by default.

items.title: Cross-language notebook reactivity
items.scope: Executed JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, and SQL cells now become visibly stale in document order after upstream changes. Refresh is explicit, replays only recorded execution evidence, preserves never-run cells, and does not pretend shared DuckDB side effects can roll back.

items.title: Live API sessions and request pipelines
items.scope: HTTP, SSE, WebSocket sessions, and named sequential HTTP pipelines now share bounded output, cancellation, secret-aware environments, captures, assertions, and a DNS-pinned SSRF-guarded desktop transport.

items.title: Project test runner
items.scope: Desktop now detects Vitest, Jest, Pytest, Go, and Cargo behind the approved project root, streams bounded output, and owns stop and timeout without invoking a shell.

items.title: Faster cold browser startup
items.scope: Monaco core, language tokenizers, execution paths, completed onboarding, and background package classification now stay outside the critical browser startup path. Source-graph guards and bundle budgets prevent those integrations from returning to first paint.

items.title: Reliable multi-file projects
items.scope: Project tree, native search, replace, curated templates, binary-safe bundle import/export, and isolated template runtime smoke ship today.

items.title: Complete CLI distribution
items.scope: Utility commands, execution, Capsule replay, completions, and stable errors ship today. A guarded manual workflow now verifies signed immutable-release evidence before promoting npm artifacts, bootstraps once with provenance, and stages later versions through OIDC plus 2FA approval. The next stable release must perform the first publish; tap promotion and public-trust Authenticode remain explicit operational gates.

items.title: Version-to-version migration coverage
items.scope: Capsules have an explicit migration registry, distinct newer-app guidance, and an automated journey that carries an immutable v0.15.0 artifact through the current shared parser, renderer importer, CLI replay, and web UI.

items.title: Deeper debugging controls
items.scope: JavaScript and TypeScript breakpoints, stepping, bounded watch evaluation, conditional breakpoints, and non-pausing logpoints ship in web and desktop. Python, Go, and Rust ship standard breakpoints, stepping, locals, call stack, and native-process watches on desktop through their host debuggers.

items.title: Multi-file import and sharing
items.scope: Share links, Capsules, bounded TypeScript and Go Playground migration, cURL, Postman, Bruno files and collection folders, Jupyter notebooks, and native notebooks ship today. Capsule Workspaces add a privacy-first multi-file viewer with explicit open-tab selection and no backend.
